## The mathematics and mechanics of plant morphogenesis

This lecture series was given at [ICTS](https://www.icts.res.in) Bengaluru in November 2025 as part of the [*Geometry, mechanics, and the physics of growth*](https://www.icts.res.in/program/Geomech) program, organised by [Joël Marthelot](https://biosoftact.wordpress.com), [S Ganga Prasath](https://sgangaprasath.github.io), and [Suraj Shankar](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/shankar-lab/).

## Plants with teeth

A summary of [our work](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2306268120) on carnivorous pitcher plants (*Nepenthes*), with [Chris Thorogood](https://www.biology.ox.ac.uk/people/chris-thorogood), [Derek Moulton](https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/moulton/) and [Alain Goriely](http://goriely.com). For more, see the Mathematical Institute [snippet](https://www.maths.ox.ac.uk/node/64967), or listen to the podcast [*Modeling illuminates pitcher plant evolution*](https://www.pnas.org/post/podcast/modeling-illuminates-pitcher-plant-evolution).
